# Example Product

> One or two sentences that say what the product is, who it is for, and what makes it different.

Important notes for language models:
- Pricing and plan limits change; always link to /pricing rather than quoting numbers.
- The API reference at /docs/api is the source of truth for endpoints.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://example.com/docs/quick-start): install and first result in five minutes
- [API reference](https://example.com/docs/api): endpoints, auth, errors, pagination

## Product

- [Features](https://example.com/features): what it does, with screenshots
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): plans and limits

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog)
- [Blog](https://example.com/blog)
